Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first step, the WebSurfer agent incorrectly identified the director of the 1972 film *Mirage* as Edward Dmytryk. The search results visible in the browser (from DuckDuckGo) clearly show that the 1972 Peruvian film *Mirage* was directed by Armando Robles Godoy, yet the agent ignored this correct information and hallucinated a famous American director (Edward Dmytryk) instead. This initial error propagated through the rest of the conversation, forcing the system to unnecessarily correct itself in later steps.
